findings.claim: Order seller names can pollute Object.prototype — The candidate creates vendedoresMap as a normal {} and indexes it with p.vendedor/p.mesero/p.creadoPor. For vendedorNombre === '__proto__', vendedoresMap[vendedorNombre] resolves Object.prototype, so initialization is skipped and lines 119-120 assign monto and subpedidos directly onto Object.prototype.

Live tenant sales and inventory mutations are only ephemeral and bypass ticket confirmation — The new cobrarVentaDirecta path immediately creates estado: 'cobrado', mutates only React state through setInventario/setPedidos, and appends to a useState ledger. MostradorPanaderiaContainer line 73 exposes this callback directly on the production tenant screen. No durable tenant-scoped write, offline persistence, immutable ledger transaction, or spooler acknowledgement appears in the changed path.

Product deletion bypasses the existing validated deletion path — The changed hunk replaces actions.eliminarProductoConValidacion(id) with actions.eliminarProducto(id), while also disconnecting the validation state from RecipeEditor by passing validacion={null} and validando={false}.

Tenant feature gate for category creation was removed — The candidate removes useAdminFeatures and the featureEnabled('admin_menu_add_category') conditional, then inserts the add-category FAB action unconditionally for every rendered admin menu.
